item.title: 🟠 Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.
JetBrains is urging Cadence users to revoke and rotate all credentials following a security incident last month in which unidentified threat actors exploited a recently disclosed critical vulnerability in TeamCity to breach its own environment. "Cadence users should immediately revoke or rotate all credentials and secrets that may have been used to run their Cadence executions," JetBrains said.

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1d

item.title: 🔵 Trezor Says ShipMonk Breach Exposed 67,000 U.S. Customers' Data It Said Was Deleted
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — review monitoring and incident-response readiness.
Hardware wallet manufacturer Trezor on Friday disclosed that another 67,000 customers from the U.S. have been impacted in a breach at its shipping provider ShipMonk. The exposed information includes customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, shipping addresses, and order numbers between November 2019 and August 2021. The breach does not affect the security of the company's hardware wallets
